# Unit 3 week 6 — Teacher learning guide
Superclass Equipment; subclasses Camera/Projector inherit stock members and override preparation. super() initialises the same instance's common state. A kit has component items; composition fits better than pretending it is a Camera.
Initial report: E01: Charge the camera; E02: Check the ventilation; E03: Check the item before use. camera.lend()=>True and available1. After charge20/hours1000: E01: Check the lens; E02: Arrange a projector check; E03 unchanged. Query calls leave stock unchanged.
Mixed-call subtype method selection demonstrates polymorphism. Interface hides storage detail (abstraction); fields/operations grouped and rules maintained (encapsulation); subclass reuses a base (inheritance). This base is concrete; Python overloading by multiple same-named definitions does not occur automatically. AudioRecorder inherits __init__ and overrides preparation; the report does not change.
Inherited lending contracts must hold for each subtype. Invalid charge/hours reject bool/non-integers and out-of-range values before mutation. Camera charge 0/19 => charge message,20/100 => lens. Projector 0/999=>ventilation,1000=>check. Empty report=>[]. These fictional thresholds are not operational equipment advice.
Pack contains a supplied base module, guided scaffold, standalone worked solution, separate practical scaffold/solution/marking guide and test log. Keep teacher solutions separate for controlled sittings. Practical replaces lesson 4, not an extra lesson. Adjust conditions/weighting through the school outline; do not claim this single task covers all OOP outcomes.
